_comment: Paths are WINDOWS paths, so this file only works under the Windows Node install: run it as "/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" tools/verify-dll.js. Under WSL's node (installed 2026-09-09) a D:\ path is not absolute on POSIX, so it resolves against the repo root and every check fails as a missing file rather than as a bad path. To switch, convert BOTH entries to /mnt/... and set FO4_WINDOWS_USER — see docs/FO4-TOOLCHAIN.md section 8. The plugin repo lives on the Windows filesystem because MSVC handles UNC working directories badly. Both xmake modes are listed; the first that exists wins.
